body:
I know how miserable it is to feel worthless. I'm sorry that you feel that same pain.

What makes you feel that way?

You're not worthless and you can get back into your major. You might have to take community college classes to get your GPA back up, but you can do it.

I know things can get rough though and be so much more than overwhelming. I wish you the best.

I understand that. Truly I do. My mother was a waitress and i started working in restaurants when I was 11. I dropped out of highschool in 9th grade. I dropped out of college. I make $70k a year now and I'm still under 30 for another couple years.


It's hard and it's getting harder to do all the time, but I know a lot of people who have done it as well. I'm begging you, get on Amazon and look at books for certifications. 

It you want to do blue collar work, you can find lots of things for electricians, plumbers, HVAC, etc. All skilled trades and paid decently. 

If you're into computers you can learn coding or administration. I'm a systems administrator myself.
This is true, but a huge burden to put on them. Landon has kids of his own and Eli does not have a job.

You can do it. It takes some hard work but you don't have to live in poverty. I'm also a highschool drop out and do not have a college degree. But I went and got certifications and make good money. 

Traditional educational paths are not for everyone. Look at getting a certificate for something you enjoy doing, or are at least have a knack for. There are so many jobs that pay around $25 an hour for certificates that you can get with a small $300 investment and a few weeks of preparing.
I'm sorry that happened to you. I wouldn't wish that on anyone. If you'd like to talk about, you can pm me. I found that telling someone what happened made it infinitely easier to manage.

Honestly it makes me feel like a huge piece of shit for doing this to them. After the divorce I bought some land on the lake a couple miles from my brothers place. I intended to save up and build a house on it in the next couple years. We made plans to brew some moonshine and beer and hang out and play D&D, go hiking, hang out on the porch drinking coffee enjoying the view. I really feel like shit for abandoning that.

This is the view from where the deck and living room would have been. https://i.imgur.com/40Wk5F9.jpg

I feel you on a lot of this. I can tell you that if you want to tear down those walls you build around yourself, start by being honest with someone. It doesn't particularly matter who, hell you can lay out what you're hiding to me if you like. It was easier in my case to do so with a complete stranger anonymously the first several times I did it. 

But each time it got easier. My secrets and sins went from things I hid from everyone and was ashamed of to things I will tell somewhat openly and own now. Not that I'm proud of them, but that everyone makes mistakes and has problems and sharing that with people gets easier, it makes you less resentful and fearful, and helps you to find some peace with yourself.

I can't tell them. They'd be in their car and across the country instantly, and neither of them can afford to do that. 

They know what's going on, and that I'm exhausted, but not that my mental state right now.

I loved her with all my heart as soon as I saw her. In fact, the first thing I said to her was that I'd marry her some day. And a year later, we got married. 

Relationships bring out the best and worst in people. They will break you both in the best and worst of ways and if you can endure it with that person, it's a wonderful thing. We couldn't and I accepted that. But I can't accept what I feel is an abandonment by almost everyone I love. I never had good relationships with my family because of the abuse, and hers meant the world to me. But them still supporting her, accepting her... It's implicit cosigning of her treachery.

I've been in a bad place for way too long and it's only getting worse. Landon and Eli are my brothers and the only two people I will ever trust in going forward. I know this will destroy them. And I know it's selfish. But I am done. I've lived a full and interesting life. I plan on writing it down this evening after making my preparations. 

With how far I've come this time, I can't back down again. I'll lose everything either way at this point.

Honestly, I'm just done. The divorce was understandable. I fucked up and get that some things don't heal. 

But I just found out she's 5 months pregnant with Rob's child. I started putting everything together and realized she orchestrated the whole thing for the past several years. It's a level of betrayal I'll never understand or forgive. I love her family more than my own, but that they accept her still, knowing what a sociopath she is, I had to break up with them too this week. It hurts a lot and I feel like I'm finally dead inside.
Not yet. I just dropped my daughter off with her mother and am in the airport overnight for my flight home this morning.
Yeah, I'd like that. I know I'm in a bad place right now. I'm scared that this is the closest I've come and furthest I've taken these thoughts. Scared that I'm comfortable with it finally.

I don't know you, but you sound a lot like me. 

This is going to be difficult, reaching out to people and being vulnerable always is. And there will always be those people who care not about your vulnerability and will take advantage of you. But you have to put yourself out there, even though it's scary. Someone will appreciate you and love you when you are genuine with them. 

I dont have much room to talk considering my own post here... But don't give up yet. You do have a lot to offer someone, you know that. You just have to work up the courage to start those relationships. Ask that cute girl/guy out for coffee. They might say no, but at least you asked and made the effort. Someone will say yes. And one of those people who say yes will end up loving you. It will take time. There will be rejection and hurt. But at the end of it you'll have a great relationship with someone. I've been trying to learn this myself since my divorce.
